import datetime

from django.contrib.admin.helpers import AdminReadonlyField
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.test import TestCase
from django.urls import reverse

from . import customadmin
from .models import Article, Section


class CustomAdminSiteReadonlyFkLinkTests(TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.superuser = User.objects.create_superuser(
            username='super', password='secret', email='super@example.com',
        )

    def setUp(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.superuser)

    def test_readonly_fk_link_uses_custom_admin_site(self):
        from django.contrib import admin

        section = Section.objects.create(name='Test section')
        Article.objects.create(
            title='a', content='c',
            date=datetime.datetime(2009, 3, 18, 11, 54, 58), section=section,
        )
        model_admin = admin.ModelAdmin(Article, customadmin.site)
        helper = AdminReadonlyField.__new__(AdminReadonlyField)
        helper.model_admin = model_admin
        remote_field = Article._meta.get_field('section').remote_field

        html = helper.get_admin_url(remote_field, section)
        expected = reverse(
            'admin:admin_views_section_change',
            args=[section.pk],
            current_app='admin2',
        )
        self.assertIn(expected, html)
        self.assertTrue(html.startswith('<a href="/admin2/'), html)

    def test_readonly_fk_link_uses_default_admin_site(self):
        from django.contrib import admin

        section = Section.objects.create(name='Test section')
        Article.objects.create(
            title='a', content='c',
            date=datetime.datetime(2009, 3, 18, 11, 54, 58), section=section,
        )
        model_admin = admin.ModelAdmin(Article, admin.site)
        helper = AdminReadonlyField.__new__(AdminReadonlyField)
        helper.model_admin = model_admin
        remote_field = Article._meta.get_field('section').remote_field

        html = helper.get_admin_url(remote_field, section)
        expected = reverse('admin:admin_views_section_change', args=[section.pk])
        self.assertIn(expected, html)
        self.assertTrue(html.startswith('<a href="/admin/'), html)
EOF
